fields.Name: Tag Distribution For Entity
fields.UserQuestion: What tags are most common on records of a given entity?
fields.Description: Aggregates tag counts across all records of a given entity, showing how many records have each tag along with average relevance weight and date range. Composable — use as a subquery or join to analyze topic distribution, category breakdowns, and tag popularity.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups vwTaggedItems by tag for a given entity name, joining to vwTags for display names and parent hierarchy. Returns COUNT, AVG(Weight), MIN/MAX tagged dates per tag. Only includes Active tags. No ORDER BY for composability — callers should add their own sorting (e.g., ORDER BY RecordCount DESC). Parameters: entityName (entity display name e.g. "Member Engagement Logs").

fields.Name: entityName
fields.Description: The display name of the entity to filter tagged items by (e.g., 'Inquiry', 'Customer').

fields.Name: TagDescription
fields.Description: Description of the tag's purpose or meaning

fields.Name: TagParentID
fields.Description: Identifier for the parent tag, if this is a sub-tag

fields.Name: ParentTagDisplayName
fields.Description: Display name of the parent tag

fields.Name: RecordCount
fields.Description: Total number of records associated with this tag for the specified entity

fields.Name: AvgWeight
fields.Description: The average weight assigned to this tag across all items

fields.Name: EarliestTaggedAt
fields.Description: The timestamp of the first time this tag was applied to a record

fields.Name: LatestTaggedAt
fields.Description: The timestamp of the most recent time this tag was applied to a record
